hints.saw: Answer in 5 s or the saw bites.

moveBlocked.panel: Close the Book of Will or use Escape to move
moveBlocked.moving: The hero is already on the move
moveBlocked.tooFar: Too far, or the way is blocked
moveBlocked.hallUnavailable: Stand next to the Knowledge book, standing still, to open the Hall

knowledge.title: Book of Will
knowledge.tooltipBody: Will is your stock of Power. Actions cost Will.
knowledge.tooltipRefillPost: refills it, so do not waste it.
knowledge.meterHint:
Answer questions correctly to
gain Will and reach milestones.
knowledge.hallLore: Knowledge is the wellspring of Will. Here you earn the Will that lets you travel the whole world — every step beyond camp and every deed draws on it. Answer true and swift: the sharper the mind, the stronger the Will.
knowledge.full: Your Will is stronger than ever! Time to set out on an adventure.
knowledge.wrong: Incorrect. Try to remember the correct answer.
knowledge.saveError: Could not read or save the challenge. Saved data has not been overwritten. Try reloading.
knowledge.rejected: Action not completed. Check your answer and the current challenge state.

b_crest.name: Human Form
fx: The body path is open: strikes, guard, movement and endurance.

b_heavy.name: Heavy Blow
fx: Knockback +1: a light enemy flies back 1 hex.
Knockback +2: flies back 2 hexes.
Knockback +3: even a heavy enemy flies back.

b_endure.name: Endurance
fx: +1 heart in every fight.
+2 hearts in every fight.

b_dash.name: Dash
fx: 1 step per location without spending Will.
2 steps per location without spending Will.
3 steps per location without spending Will.

b_cap.name: Iron Body
fx: The first enemy hit in each fight deals no damage.

d_crest.name: Dark Mark
fx: Awakens dark magic: curses, fear and the price of blood.

d_curse.name: Curse
d_curse.fx: An enemy in combat loses {bonus} defense.

d_blood.name: Blood Price
fx: Once per location: pay 1 heart instead of 3 Will.
Twice per location: pay 1 heart instead of 3 Will.
3 times per location: pay 1 heart instead of 3 Will.

d_fear.name: Fear
fx: Drives an enemy back 1 hex without a strike.
Drives an enemy back 2 hexes.
Drives all adjacent enemies back 1 hex.

d_shadow.name: Shadow Step
fx: Pass through 1 occupied hex.
Pass through 2 occupied hexes.

d_devour.name: Devourer
fx: +1 Will for every won fight.
+2 Will for every won fight.
+3 Will for every won fight.

d_sight.name: Dark Sight
fx: See enemies in fog 1 hex further.
See enemies in fog 2 hexes further.

d_cap.name: Demonic Form
fx: Once per fight: double attack at the cost of 1 heart.

a_crest.name: Blessing
fx: Awakens holy magic: the gate, light and healing.

a_teleport.name: Teleport
a_teleport.fx: Lets you open a portal to camp with a scroll. Portal cost: {cost} Will.

a_heal.name: Healing
fx: Once per location restore 1 heart.
Twice per location restore 1 heart.
3 times per location restore 1 heart.

a_gate2.name: Two-way Gate
fx: A portal from a dungeon no longer destroys it: return to where you stopped.

a_ward.name: Light Ward
fx: +1 block against the first hit in a fight.
+2 blocks against the first hit in a fight.
+3 blocks against the first hit in a fight.

a_wings.name: Wings
fx: Fly over 1 obstacle per turn.
Fly over 2 obstacles per turn.

a_light.name: Light
fx: Fog lifts 1 hex further.
Fog lifts 2 hexes further.

a_cap.name: Angelic Form
fx: Once per location the Teleport opens for free.

portal.oneWay: One-way — the cave will be lost

refusal.IN_CAMPING: Portals can't be opened in the camp
refusal.PORTAL_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open portal
refusal.NOT_YOUR_PORTAL: This portal belongs to another hero

log.hit: hits {target}: −{hearts, plural, one {# heart} other {# hearts}}.
log.swept: swing also catches {target}: −{hearts, plural, one {# heart} other {# hearts}}.
log.defeat: Defeat — the hero returns to camp.

battle.fallen: Not enough hearts to survive that. {name} has fallen and returns to camp.

defend.tapRed: tap hexes around you to raise shields before the line runs out.
defend.noShield: No shield in hand — you can take one on your turn (swap, 4 Will).

aim.text: Choose the hex to strike from. The defender raised shields somewhere around — you cannot see where. No choice in time — you strike from here.
aim.none: The defender raised no shield — the strike lands.

text.saw: You stepped onto the saw. Answer before the line runs out to jump clear. Wrong or late — the saw takes half your hearts.
text.push: Answer before the line runs out to push. Wrong or late — the push fails and the Will is spent.

hint.struck: Struck {name}. It only sees a red ring — step away to hide your side.
hint.hitTaken: The strike landed: −{hearts} heart. Shields burned: {burned}.
hint.sawDodged: Dodged the saw ({answer}) — thrown back, no damage.
hint.sawCut: {late, select, yes {Too slow} other {Wrong answer}} — it was {answer}. The saw cuts — thrown back.
hint.displaced: {mode, select, push {Pushed} other {Pulled}} {name}.{slid, select, yes { It slid on the oil.} other {}}{fell, select, yes { It fell off the ledge.} other {}}
hint.displaceFailed: {late, select, yes {Too slow} other {Wrong answer}} — it was {answer}. It did not budge; the Will is spent.
hint.swapped: Took {item} into the {hand, select, right {right hand} other {left hand}}.
hint.used: Used {item}: +{hearts} heart. The hand is empty now.

act.move: Tap a blue hex to move — every step costs 1 Will.
act.strike: Scroll to choose a tool, point it at an enemy or at a side next to you and press its button.
act.push: Tap an adjacent enemy — it is pushed 1 hex away from you.
act.swap: Pick an item from the bag for the {hand, select, right {right hand} other {left hand}} — tap a hand to switch.

reject.HAND_ALREADY_STRUCK: That hand already struck this turn.
reject.NO_SHIELD_IN_HAND: No shield in hand. You can take one on your turn — a swap costs 4 Will.
reject.SHIELD_CAPACITY_REACHED: Your shield covers no more sides.
reject.NOT_IN_RING: Shields go only on the red hexes.
reject.NO_TASK: There is no task to answer.
reject.TOO_CLOSE: Too close for a ranged strike.
reject.NOT_AN_OPTION: You cannot strike from that hex.
reject.AIM_PENDING: Choose the hex of the strike first.
reject.WINDOW_CLOSED: The time is up — the window is closed.

stash.title: Camp Stash

hint.idle: Drag items between the bag and the stash, or double-click to send one across. Stored items weigh nothing.
hint.drag: Release over a cell or a panel. Esc cancels.
hint.split: Moving half of the stack. Esc cancels.

error.WRONG_SLOT: This item does not fit that slot.
error.SWAP_WRONG_SLOT: The other item does not fit the slot it would go back to.
error.SPLIT_TARGET_TAKEN: Split a stack onto an empty cell or the same kind of stack.
error.EMPTY_SOURCE: There is nothing in that cell.

pay.hint: Put coins in your hand and drag them over the Stash Chest to unlock it.
